topic.title: Reading Input from the Console
topic.description: Using Scanner class to read user input

sections.title: What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Ever wondered how programs talk to users? Today, you'll learn how to read input from the console - like having a conversation with your code!

• How to use the Scanner class to read user input
• Different methods to read numbers, text, and more
• Common mistakes to avoid when reading input

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content:
Imagine the Scanner class like a friendly receptionist at a hotel. When a guest (user) arrives, the receptionist (Scanner) asks for their details and writes them down for you.

The Scanner class helps your program 'listen' to what the user types. Here's how it works:

• First, you create a Scanner object that listens to the keyboard (System.in)
• Then you ask the user for input with a clear prompt
• Finally, you read what they typed using special methods

sections.title: Code Examples
Key Points
points: The Scanner class is in java.util and must be imported to read console input
Create a Scanner with: Scanner input = new Scanner(System.in)
nextInt() reads an integer, nextDouble() reads a decimal, nextLine() reads a full line
Always display a prompt message before reading input so users know what to enter
next() reads one token (word), while nextLine() reads the entire remaining line

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Scanner class is your program's way of listening to user input. Always use clear prompts so users know what to enter. Match the method to the data type (nextInt(), nextDouble(), nextLine()) Practice makes perfect - try reading different types of input.

questions.question: Which class is used to read input from the console in Java?
questions.explanation: The Scanner class (java.util.Scanner) is the standard way to read input from the console. You create it with: Scanner input = new Scanner(System.in);

questions.question: Which Scanner method reads an integer value from the user?
questions.explanation: The nextInt() method of the Scanner class reads the next integer value from the input. Other methods include nextDouble(), nextLine(), and next().
